entries.title: Spot daily hours patterns
entries.description: View a Daily Hours heat map on Machine pages, Job pages and the Dashboard when you have report access. Hover over a day to see its hours, with estimates clearly marked when readings span several days.

entries.title: Browse and filter fleet history
entries.description: Search Machine and Implement History, filter by date or kind, and sort the results. Use Load more to browse older records.

entries.title: Load John Deere machines more reliably
entries.description: Missing names and variations in John Deere's machine and hours data no longer prevent supported results from loading. Data errors now identify the field causing the problem.

entries.title: Fetch hours as soon as you link a Machine
entries.description: Linking a Machine now requests its John Deere hours immediately. If John Deere refuses the request, the link stays saved and shows the failure for a later retry.

entries.title: View a better-fitting Dashboard
entries.description: Dashboard rows now fill the available space using the tiles your role can see, avoiding gaps when some tiles are hidden.

entries.title: Scan more compact dashboard tiles
entries.description: Small dashboard tiles now fit their contents, reducing unnecessary empty space.
